name: Boys & Girls Club of Burlington Summer Camp
description_short: An eight-week, full-day summer camp from the last week of June through late August, offered as two four-week sessions. Campers get meals and snacks, swimming lessons in the Club pool, tennis, outdoor exploration and help with summer learning plans.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming lessons and water safety in the Club pool; the page says more than 120 children and teens build swimming skills there each year.
